title: Coder build slots grow to 30–70 GB each and fill disks; prune them
body: Observed 2026-10-03: on coderos-4080 (937 GB) each `~/.openagents/targets/*-slot-N` grows to 30–70 GB; with 3 parallel `chat work` batches the disk went from 145 GB free to <5 GB within an hour, twice; the Mac's `~/.openagents/targets` reached 126 GB in an hour. Slots accumulate artifacts of every commit/feature combination they build. Add slot hygiene: (1) after a run releases a slot, if the slot is over a size cap (default 25 GB, user-configurable) or free disk is under a floor, run `cargo sweep`-style pruning (delete artifacts older than the slot's last N builds / older than the current toolchain+lock), or clear the slot's `incremental` and stale `deps`; (2) when free disk is below a floor, don't start a new slot — wait or build smaller; (3) report slot sizes in `openagents worktree ls` / background view. Builds must stay warm for the common case. Tests with a fake slot tree. Related: #10291 (worktree removal), #10293 (slots).
